rag.title: RAG & Ingestion
rag.description: Turn scattered source files into current, authorized evidence.
rag.note: WASM / Edge is a target integration. Durable local ingestion uses SQLite checkpoints; Inngest is an adapter.

agents.title: Multi-Agent Analysis
agents.description: Combine quote economics and factory constraints into a reviewable proposal.
agents.note: Typed task envelopes run within one LangGraph. Unresolved constraints block approval; managers review external commitments.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Working context, event recall, confirmed facts and procedural skills.
memory.note: Working context, procedural rules, semantic facts and dated events form one memory lifecycle.

eval.title: Automated Agent Evaluation
eval.description: Benchmark synthesis, multi-turn simulation and deterministic business assertions.
eval.note: Recorded synthetic suite: 23/23 business cases passed. Current execution uses the local authored harness and separate model judge. IntellAgent is a proposed framework integration; it did not produce the recorded 23 cases. Reference: https://github.com/plurai-ai/intellagent

retrieval.title: Hybrid RAG & Retrieval
retrieval.description: Scoped lexical and vector retrieval with active-version filtering and cross-encoder reranking.
retrieval.note: WASM / Edge is a target integration. Durable local ingestion uses SQLite checkpoints; Inngest is an adapter.

ml.title: ML Risk Model
ml.description: Rolling time-series features, temporal splits and calibrated delay-risk scoring.
ml.note: Planned V2 integration: SageMaker, XGBoost, MLflow and approved batch scoring. Recall 55% → 85% and five-day earlier warnings are design targets, not measured results. The prior separate synthetic logistic prototype achieved approximately 54.3% recall at the same alert budget as its rules baseline; it is not an XGBoost/SageMaker deployment.

tracing.title: Agent Tracing & Debugging
tracing.description: LangSmith waterfall traces, token and latency profiling, and root-cause diagnosis.
tracing.note: Real LangSmith traces were verified for all 23 recorded acceptance cases. Four-level diagnosis is a review workflow across data, retrieval, tools and decisions, not an automatic root-cause classifier.

security.title: Agent Security
security.description: Input, output and tool guardrails. Prompt injection, behavior alignment and access control.
security.note: LlamaFirewall integration is a proposed design, not installed or evaluated here. Existing code validates payloads, customer scope and tool contracts. PII policies, tool allowlists and authorization require application enforcement alongside scanners. Reference: https://github.com/meta-llama/PurpleLlama/tree/main/LlamaFirewall

deployment.title: Agent Deployment
deployment.description: AWS Bedrock AgentCore microservice runtime with Docker and standard HTTP contracts.
deployment.note: AgentCore local /ping and /invocations checks passed. Dockerfile static checks passed. Container execution and AWS deployment remain unverified.
